title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC tip — that denial can also be shown by the next argument (imputation vs inherent)
pass_a_gloss: Tip: Placeus will also prove that denial by the next argument, to show how pernicious the opinion is that he is trying to move Garrigues from. Tip before imputation-vs-inhaerentia.
pass_b_english: Which very thing can also be brought about by this argument, so that you may see more and more how pernicious that opinion is from which I desire and strive to move you.
source_text: Quod ipsum etiam effici potest hoc argumento, ut videas magis magisque quam perniciosa sit illa sententia, a qua te dimovere cupio & conor.

choices.choice: Next argument shows how pernicious; tip before inhaerentia

notes: Cap. IX missa/poena densify section 646 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 354–355 tip).
